messages:
Alex: Quick question — if you could only ever use ONE emoji for the rest of your life, which would it be? Choose wisely. :thinking:
Marie: 😂 — absolutely. It's the Swiss Army knife of reactions.
Sam: ❤️ for me. Covers compliments, sympathy, and passive-aggressive workplace appreciation.
Jen C.: 👀 for drama and attention. Also perfect for 'did you see this?' follow-ups.
Tariq: 🫠 (melting face) — subtle, very versatile when things go sideways.
Leila: 🤖 I would lean into it and become a robot. It'd be iconic.
Nate: 🥲 — bittersweet but expressive.
Marie: Also, quick rules: no swapping for holidays, no alternate accounts. One emoji, forever.
PollBot: Poll created: "One Emoji Forever" — options: 😂 / ❤️ / 👀 / 🤔 / 🥲 / 🫠 / 🤖
Alex: I'm surprised nobody picked 🤔 (thinking face) — that's my vote.
Jen C.: @Alex, you and your commitment to nuance. :laughing:
Tariq: Reminder: you can still use punctuation and gifs, right? Asking for a friend.
Leila: Technically yes, but the emoji is our primary emotional compression unit now.
PollBot: Current votes — Alex(🤔), Marie(😂), Sam(❤️), Jen C.(👀), Tariq(🫠), Leila(🤖), Nate(🥲)
Alex: Wild — every vote is different. Is this the most democratic poll ever?
Marie: This feels like the perfect metaphor for our team.
Nate: Plot twist: the truly chaotic option was nobody picking the classic 👍
Jen C.: Imagine accidentally reacting with the wrong forever-emoji. Nightmare fuel.
PollBot: Final tally (tie breaker not implemented): 😂:1, ❤️:1, 👀:1, 🤔:1, 🥲:1, 🫠:1, 🤖:1
Alex: OK this thread settled nothing but made my day. Thanks, team :party_parrot:
